name: Stamped
summary: Reviews, ratings and loyalty platform for e-commerce: collect product reviews and user-generated content, run rewards and loyalty programs, and show social proof to lift conversions on Shopify and other stores.
best_for: mid-market Shopify brands that want reviews and loyalty in one platform instead of juggling separate apps
skip_if: you're an early-stage store — the removed free plan and $199+/product pricing are steep before you have the volume to justify them
honest_knock: The $798/month figure that circulates for the full suite is real, but it is a floor rather than a ceiling: that is what multi-product access costs from the 5,000-order step, and below that step you cannot buy the bundle at all — the pricing page sells Reviews on its own, $23/month at 200 orders and $99 at 1,000, and does not show Repeat or Loyalty. So the ladder has a cliff in it rather than a slope. Crossing 5,000 orders doubles Reviews from $99 to $199, and wanting a second product moves you to $798. A second storefront is another $100 a month on top, and past 20,000 orders every card turns into "Talk to Sales". Start with one product and price the step above the volume you actually expect.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month at the 200-order volume step (no free plan)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 12 September 2026, read in a browser on their own pricing page across every step of the order-volume selector and both the single-product and bundle tabs) There is no free plan, and what you can actually buy depends on your monthly order volume. Below 5,000 orders a month the page sells only one product: Reviews, at $23/month at the 200-order step and $99/month at 1,000 orders. Repeat and Loyalty do not appear at those volumes at all. At the 5,000-order step the full line-up shows up — Repeat $499/month, Loyalty $299/month, Reviews $199/month — and the Multi-Product Bundle, which advertises 20% off, is a flat $798/month. The bundle tab locks the 200- and 1,000-order steps, so $798 is the entry price for taking more than one product, not a figure from the top of a ladder. From 20,000 orders upward, Unlimited included, every card turns into "Custom plan — Talk to Sales". Their FAQ says the same thing in words: plans start at $199/month for a single product and $798/month for multi-product access, and smaller brands are pointed at the self-serve plans in Stamped's Shopify App listings instead. Plans include up to two domains, each additional store gets its first month free, and additional domains are $100/month each. Sales tax is added as a separate line item. The redesigned page no longer says anything about overage charges.
